data.display_address: Sobha Hartland II, Mohammed Bin Rashid City, Dubai
data.long_description:
Riverside Crescent at Sobha Hartland 2 is a newly unveiled luxurious residential tower, setting an extraordinary standard for upscale living in Dubai. This stunning 70-story development features sky gardens and an observation deck with panoramic views of lagoons, beaches, Meydan Racecourse, and a nearby wildlife sanctuary.

The prime location offers access to a wealth of sports facilities, retail outlets, dining options, and recreational amenities, making it a perfect blend of luxury and convenience for those who seek the best of Dubai living.

Prime Location:

5 min - Ras Al Khor
10 min - Meydan Race Course
10 min - Sobha Hartland 2 International Schools
12 min - Dubai International Airport
12 min - Business Bay
15 min - Dubai Mall
15 min - Burj Khalifa
15 min - Dubai Frame
15 min - Dubai Opera
25 min - Palm Jumeirah

310 Riverside Crescent offers everything you need for a sophisticated lifestyle, all within minutes of Dubai’s top destinations.
